claims: One connector gives Claude access to 'thousands of scrapers' for Google Maps, social platforms, websites, competitor tracking
Apify free account includes $5 of credit every month
Setup takes about 30 seconds / three steps
Creator: Stanford founder of an AI startup that raised $4 million; personally uses it for scraping LinkedIn and competitor data
how_to_steps: Step 1: go to apify.com and create a free account ($5 free credit per month)
Step 2: open Claude -> Settings -> Connectors -> search 'Apify' -> Install -> Enable
Step 3: start a new Claude chat and ask: 'Based on what you know about me, map out the best ways to use Apify for my business.'
Use the resulting ideas (competitor sites, reviews, social signals) as scraping tasks
on_screen_only: apify.com homepage: '58,344 tools for your AI', 'Actors now work where you do', logos of enterprise customers

Claude composer with the exact prompt 'Based on what you know about me, map out the best ways to use Apify for my business.' and model 'Sonnet 5 · High', tabs 'Chat' / 'Cowork', 'Project or folder', 'Manual'
cta: Comment what you try it for; follow for AI founder content

relevance.why: Competitor/lead research is a recurring founder chore; a hosted scraper library reachable from Claude (and via MCP from Claude Code) cuts that to minutes. Veteran-business angles: scrape VA/SBA directories, local Google Maps leads.

implement_score.why: Low effort (free account + connector). Real cost is per-actor compute beyond $5; LinkedIn scraping carries ToS/legal risk. Worth enabling for Google Maps/review scraping and competitor pricing checks.
